"GAME TITLE: GTA KERALA – GOD'S OWN COUNTRY

Create a massive, realistic, 3D open-world action-adventure mobile game inspired by the freedom, exploration and gameplay of GTA 5.

The entire game world must be based on REAL KERALA, INDIA.

Platform: Android and iOS
Perspective: Third-person and first-person camera
Graphics: Realistic 3D, cinematic lighting, HD textures
World: Open-world Kerala with all 14 districts
Gameplay: Driving, walking, exploring, missions, racing, shopping, boating, character customization and side activities.

WORLD MAP – ALL 14 DISTRICTS

Create one connected Kerala map featuring these 14 districts:

1. Thiruvananthapuram
2. Kollam
3. Pathanamthitta
4. Alappuzha
5. Kottayam
6. Idukki
7. Ernakulam
8. Thrissur
9. Palakkad
10. Malappuram
11. Kozhikode
12. Wayanad
13. Kannur
14. Kasaragod

Every district must have its own realistic environment, roads, buildings, landmarks, villages and cities.

FAMOUS LOCATIONS

Include real-world-inspired locations:

Thiruvananthapuram:

- Padmanabhaswamy Temple surroundings
- Kovalam Beach
- Varkala Cliff
- Technopark
- Neyyar Dam

Kollam:

- Ashtamudi Lake
- Jatayu Earth's Center
- Kollam Beach
- Thenmala

Pathanamthitta:

- Sabarimala surroundings
- Gavi
- Konni
- Perunthenaruvi Waterfalls

Alappuzha:

- Alleppey Backwaters
- Houseboat areas
- Marari Beach
- Kuttanad

Kottayam:

- Kumarakom
- Vembanad Lake
- Illikkal Kallu
- Vagamon

Idukki:

- Munnar
- Thekkady
- Idukki Dam
- Eravikulam
- Ramakkalmedu

Ernakulam:

- Kochi City
- Marine Drive
- Fort Kochi
- Mattancherry
- Lulu Mall-inspired shopping district
- Kakkanad
- Vypin Island

Thrissur:

- Vadakkunnathan Temple surroundings
- Thrissur Round
- Athirappilly Waterfalls
- Guruvayur surroundings
- Chavakkad Beach

Palakkad:

- Palakkad Fort
- Malampuzha Dam
- Silent Valley
- Nelliyampathy
- Parambikulam
- Ottapalam
- Palakkad Town

Malappuram:

- Kottakkunnu
- Nilambur
- Ponnani Beach
- Kadalundi
- Kozhippara Waterfalls

Kozhikode:

- Kozhikode Beach
- Mananchira Square
- Beypore
- Kappad Beach
- Thusharagiri Waterfalls

Wayanad:

- Banasura Sagar Dam
- Pookode Lake
- Edakkal Caves
- Chembra Peak
- Soochipara Waterfalls
- Thirunelli

Kannur:

- Muzhappilangad Drive-in Beach
- St. Angelo Fort
- Payyambalam Beach
- Parassinikadavu
- Dharmadam Island

Kasaragod:

- Bekal Fort
- Bekal Beach
- Ranipuram
- Chandragiri Fort
- Ananthapura Lake Temple surroundings

VEHICLES

Add realistic Kerala vehicles:

- KSRTC buses
- Private buses
- Cars
- SUVs
- Bikes
- Scooters
- Autos
- Trucks
- Jeeps
- Police vehicles
- Boats
- Houseboats

Include Kerala-style vehicle horns, traffic, road conditions and Malayalam number plates.

GAME WORLD FEATURES

- Complete Kerala road network
- National highways and state highways
- Village roads and city roads
- Railway stations and railway crossings
- Airports
- Bus stations
- Beaches and backwaters
- Tea plantations and forests
- Shopping malls and markets
- Restaurants and tea shops
- Hospitals and colleges
- Petrol pumps and garages

GAMEPLAY

- Free-roam exploration
- Story missions
- Driving missions
- Car and bike racing
- Taxi and auto driving
- Delivery missions
- Tourist exploration
- Character customization
- Vehicle customization
- Property purchasing
- In-game mobile phone
- Malayalam radio stations
- Dynamic weather
- Day and night cycle
- Realistic monsoon rain
- Traffic AI and pedestrians

GRAPHICS

Create realistic Kerala environments with:

- 4K-quality environmental assets where supported
- Realistic water reflections
- Green coconut trees
- Kerala architecture
- Realistic mountains and rivers
- Cinematic sunsets
- Volumetric clouds
- Rain and fog
- Realistic vehicle physics
- Lifelike NPC animations

MOBILE OPTIMIZATION

- Android and iOS support
- Touchscreen controls
- Virtual steering wheel
- Driving and walking controls
- Customizable graphics settings
- Low, Medium, High and Ultra graphics
- Optimized open-world streaming
- Save game system
- Offline single-player mode

I

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

Built a playable 3D Kerala driving game in `index.html`. It includes a drivable SUV, third- and first-person cameras, walking mode, a district selector for all 14 districts, landmark-inspired scenery, a tourism mission, mobile touch controls, and a HUD with a minimap, speed, weather, and clock.

**Run it:** serve the project directory over HTTP (for example, `python3 -m http.server 3002`) and open it in a browser. Three.js is loaded from a CDN, so the first launch needs an internet connection.

**Assumptions and scope:** This is a lightweight browser-game prototype, not a full-scale GTA 5-sized mobile production. Districts are stylized, fictionalized game areas inspired by the listed real places; the game does not include surveyed real-world geography, complete road networks, full vehicle/NPC systems, or native Android/iOS builds. Syntax was checked, and a browser screenshot confirmed the scene renders.
